$comment: Deliberately minimal: values.yaml and templates/guards.yaml are the contract. This file exists for the one check a template cannot make. `nats` is the bundled upstream nats chart's values, whose templates run before this chart's guards, so a values file that still sets the old client key `nats.service` (a string; it moved to natsClient.service) would fail inside the upstream chart with an error that names neither key. Schema validation runs before any template.

service.description: The bundled NATS server's Service settings (upstream nats chart). The NATS client's service NAME moved to natsClient.service; see docs/UPGRADING.md, 'One chart: NATS bundled'.
